title: Global Hub
content: Welcome to the Command Center. This top bar shows your current target, active agents, and top-level financial or statistical metrics for your missions.

title: Actionable Alerts
content: This section highlights critical findings that require your immediate attention, such as newly discovered assets or critical vulnerabilities.

title: Activity Stream
content: Watch your agents work in real-time. This terminal provides a live feed of actions being taken across all active agents.

title: Quick Start Use Cases
content: Launch predefined attack scenarios with a single click. Useful for testing standard workflows like eCommerce checkout exploits.

title: Custom Target Scan
content: Enter any custom URL, endpoint, or IP range here to dispatch your agents for a targeted, deep scan.

title: Priority Queue
content: Review and verify vulnerabilities discovered by agents before they are compiled into reports or remediation plans.

title: Topic Theory Wiki
content: Access the theory library to explore deep technical knowledge and references for the current context.
